meta.guide_tau: Level caption:  energy (NIST, or a measurement of the last 20 years where one exists) and measured lifetime (where one exists).
meta.notes: Isotope shifts are nu(first)-nu(second) as in the source (delta nu_{56,54} = nu56 - nu54). 57Fe has I=1/2 so only A constants exist. O'Brian 1991 Table 1 was read from the scanned PDF (text layer checked against the page image). Lifetime uncertainties for O'Brian/Belmonte are the papers' blanket 'larger of 5 % or 0.2 ns'. rme_J_ea0 values are derived from measured A (S = A g_upper lambda_vac^3 / 2.0261e18, lambda in Angstrom). WebSearch was unavailable in this session (budget exhausted); sources were located through DOI/bibliographic lookups (Crossref, OpenAlex), VizieR, ADS and arXiv.

transitions.use: 372 nm resonance line: laser collimation / cooling of an Fe atomic beam on a leaky transition (Smeets et al. 2005) and optical pumping of ground-state atoms into metastable a5F5 for the 358 nm cooling scheme (Huet et al. 2015); natural linewidth 2.59(2) MHz and saturation intensity 6.57(4) mW/cm2 as quoted by Krins et al. 2009
